name: Hang Power Clean
instructions: Stand holding a barbell at mid-thigh with an overhand grip, hips pushed back and torso slightly forward.
Jump powerfully by extending your hips, knees and ankles.
Shrug and pull your elbows up and out as the bar rises.
Drop quickly under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower the bar to the hang position with control.
cues: Catch with a soft knee bend
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: An Olympic lift where you pull the bar from the hang position and catch it at shoulder height in a partial squat.
